- HOT WATER BOTTLE BABUSHKA delivered £3,215.95 TW and PAPER CHAIN KIT VINTAGE CHRISTMAS £2,500.80 TW; the top 5 products together held 19.5% of TOTAL revenue TW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER added £3,339.80 WoW and CERAMIC CAKE STAND + HANGING CAKES added £2,047.29 WoW.
- HEART OF WICKER SMALL gained £1,726.29 WoW, a rise of 2,158.1% WoW.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS fell £3,284.71 WoW, ROTATING SILVER ANGELS T-LIGHT HLDR fell £2,313.04 WoW, and 3 HEARTS HANGING DECORATION RUSTIC fell £2,061.23 WoW.
